scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Hello!
What's up?
I'm a specialist
for refining items,
but I don't work anymore.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
你好，有事吗？我是装备精炼专家，不过已经不干了。

scripts.text: I'll go on my way.
scripts.translation: 我先走了

scripts.text: Hmm... this makes me curious.
scripts.translation: 嗯...这让我很好奇

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Take care, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
保重，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Actually, I sometimes provide refine services for adventurers with a ^006400Refine Ticket^000000...
Bye bye~!
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
其实，我偶尔也会为持有^006400精炼券^000000的冒险者提供精炼服务...
再见啦~！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Greetings!
I can refine an item up to the ^006400same level as your ticket^000000.
You don't have to worry! There's no chance of breaking your item.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
你好！我能把装备精炼到^006400精炼券指定的等级^000000。
放心，装备绝不会损毁。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text: Refine item with ticket.
scripts.translation: 使用精炼券精炼装备

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Okay.
You can come again later.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
好的。
你稍后可以再来。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Which equipment would you like to refine?
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
你想精炼哪件装备？

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
You have to equip the item you want to refine.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
请先穿戴要精炼的装备。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Oh, I'm sorry.
This item is impossible to refine.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
哦，抱歉。
这件物品无法精炼。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
If you want to refine this ^006400{0}^000000, please come along with ^006400{1} Refine Ticket^000000.
See you later!

[Refine Master]
Please choose which ^006400{0} Refine Ticket^000000 you want to use.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
请选择要使用的^006400{0}精炼券^000000。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
{0} is not in your inventory. Did you put it in your storage?
Please check again.
See you later!
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
你的物品栏里没有{0}。你把它放进仓库了吗？
请再次确认。
回头见！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
^8B4513This item is already refined as much as your deed.^000000
Please come along with an item refined less than your ticket.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
^8B4513这件装备已经达到精炼券指定的精炼值。^000000
请换一件精炼值更低的装备。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
I'm going to refine ^006400{0}^8B4513 up to the +{1} level^000000 with ^006400{2}^000000.
May I proceed?
No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Oh, you changed your mind.
Ok.
You can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
哦，改主意了？好，以后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Great.
As you wish!
I have my own special way to refine...
.......ka boom!
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
好，如你所愿！
我有独门的精炼方法...
...轰隆！

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Great.
As you wish!
I have my own special way to refine...
.......ka boom!
[Refine Master]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
好，如你所愿！
我有独门的精炼方法...
...轰隆！
[精炼大师]
等等...你以为我傻吗？！
居然趁我不注意换了装备！出去！

scripts.text:
Error!
Please report this.
scripts.translation:
错误！
请报告此问题。

scripts.text:
[Refine Master]
Alright, here it is~
Well, ^0000FF{0}^000000!
Congratulations on your shining {1}.
You look GREAT!
Farewell~!
scripts.translation:
[精炼大师]
好了，拿去~
看这^0000FF{0}^000000！
恭喜，你的{1}闪闪发亮，真神气！
再见~！
